description.zh: 极简待办清单：L1 想法 / L2 目标 / L3 执行三档，拖动排序，红 / 黄 / 绿优先级圆点，按组件保存
description.en: A minimal to-do list in three tiers — L1 ideas, L2 goals, L3 actions — with drag to reorder and red / amber / green priority dots

items.zh: 一件事从「还没想清楚」到「现在就能做」，中间过三档：L1 想法、L2 目标、L3 执行。
items.en: Something moves through three tiers as it gets concrete: L1 ideas, L2 goals, L3 actions.

items.zh: 顶上三颗页签切档，一次看一档；输入框加的那条落在你正在看的这一档。
items.en: The three tabs switch tiers, one at a time; a new item lands in the tier you are looking at.

items.zh: L1 没有勾选框 —— 想法只有两个出口：升格成目标，或者删掉。「想法完成了」没有意义。
items.en: L1 has no checkbox: an idea has two exits — promote it to a goal, or delete it.

items.zh: 行尾的 ⋯ 里有升格 / 降格 / 删除；也可以把一行直接拖到页签上松手。
items.en: The ⋯ at the end of a row holds Promote / Demote / Delete — or drag a row onto a tab.

items.zh: 档位和优先级是两个轴：一条 L3 的执行项照样可以是红色。
items.en: Tier and priority are separate axes: an L3 action can still be red.

items.zh: 0.2.1 的老待办都在 L3。升级之后 L1、L2 是空的，不是数据丢了。
items.en: Old to-dos from 0.2.1 all land in L3. Empty L1 and L2 after upgrading is expected.

items.zh: 在底下的框里输入，按回车。
items.en: Type in the box at the bottom and press Enter.

items.zh: 点一行的任意位置就能勾掉 —— 整行都可点，不只是那个小方框。L2、L3 才有勾选框。
items.en: Click anywhere on a row to tick it off — the whole row is the target, not just the small box. Only L2 and L3 have checkboxes.

items.zh: 再点一下放回列表。
items.en: Click it again to put it back on the list.

items.zh: 标题栏的计数说的是这一档还剩几项，全勾完就是「全部完成」；L1 那档数的是总条数。
items.en: The counter says how many are left in this tier, or All done; on L1 it counts every idea.

items.zh: 点圆点依次切换：高 → 中 → 低 → 不设优先级。
items.en: Click the dot to cycle: High → Medium → Low → no priority.

items.zh: 第一下给「高」—— 想标一下通常就是因为「这条要紧」。
items.en: The first click gives High, because "this one matters" is the usual reason to mark something.

items.zh: 空心圈表示还没设优先级 —— 画出来而不是藏起来，你才找得到它。
items.en: An empty circle means no priority yet — it is drawn rather than hidden so you can find it.

items.zh: 把一行往上或往下拖。要挪过几个像素才真的开始动，所以点一下仍然是勾掉。
items.en: Drag a row up or down. It only starts moving after a few pixels, so a click still ticks it off.

items.zh: 拖到上边缘或下边缘，列表会跟着滚。
items.en: Drag to the top or bottom edge and the list scrolls with you.

items.zh: 拖到一半按 Esc，它会回原位。
items.en: Press Esc in the middle of a drag to drop it back where it was.

items.zh: 摆几个待办都显示同一份清单 —— 数据按组件存，不按这一份实例。
items.en: Every Todo widget you place shows the same list — it is stored per widget, not per copy.

items.zh: 并排两个待办是同一份清单的两个视图，不是两份清单。切页签也一样：这边切到 L2，那边跟着切 —— 它们看的是同一份东西。
items.en: Two Todos side by side are two views of one list, not two separate lists. Switching tabs is the same: pick L2 here and the other follows.

items.zh: 想要第二份清单，就换个 id 再装一份。
items.en: If you want a second list, install a copy under a different id.

items.zh: 写盘失败时计数会变成「未保存」—— 通常是缺存储权限。
items.en: The counter switches to Not saved when a write fails — usually a missing storage permission.

items.zh: 把鼠标停上去能看到原因。清单会先在内存里照常工作，等能写了再存。
items.en: Hover it to see the reason. The list keeps working in memory until it can write again.

changes.zh: 一件事分三档：L1 想法 / L2 目标 / L3 执行。顶上三颗页签切档，加的那条落在当前档。
changes.en: Three tiers now: L1 ideas, L2 goals, L3 actions. Tabs switch tiers, and new items land in the current one.

changes.zh: 行尾的 × 换成 ⋯：升格 / 降格 / 删除都在里面，也可以把一行拖到页签上松手。
changes.en: The × at the end of a row became ⋯: promote, demote and delete live there — or drag a row onto a tab.

changes.zh: L1 没有勾选框 —— 想法要么升格成目标，要么删掉。
changes.en: L1 has no checkbox: an idea is either promoted to a goal or deleted.

changes.zh: 老待办一条不丢，全部落在 L3。
changes.en: No old to-do is lost — they all land in L3.

changes.zh: 界面和说明都支持中文了：计数写「还剩 2 项」，全勾完是「全部完成」。
changes.en: Interface and help are bilingual now: the counter reads 2 left, or All done when everything is ticked.

changes.zh: 可以拖动一行排序；拖到边缘时列表跟着滚。
changes.en: Drag a row to reorder; the list scrolls when you drag to an edge.

changes.zh: 拖到一半按 Esc，这一行回原位。
changes.en: Press Esc mid-drag to drop the row back where it was.

changes.zh: 列表在手下变了，不会再把正拖着的那一行抽走。
changes.en: A list that changes under your hand no longer yanks the row out of the drag.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：回车添加，点一行勾掉，× 删除。
changes.en: First release: add with Enter, tick off by clicking a row, delete with ×.

changes.zh: 红 / 黄 / 绿优先级圆点，点一下切一档。
changes.en: Red / amber / green priority dots, one click to cycle.
